subject: general
question: At which of the following places in the Indus valley civilisation a brick structure has been identified as a dockyard meant for berthing ships and handling cargo?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lothal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lothal** is an important site of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• It is located in the modern state of **Gujarat, India**.
 
• Lothal is renowned for its **well-planned dockyard**, which was used for berthing ships and handling cargo.
